rate.notes: '0.60%'. Note (05): excludes mutual funds, Maof options and futures but includes a tracking fund (קרן מחקה) and a fund whose units are listed on TASE, so Israeli ETFs and listed fund units pay this line. Note (06): the fee never exceeds 25% of the money value. Note (03): an unexecuted order pays the minimum only when a clerk was involved; a split order pays one fee per day. Additional expenses: TASE payments per the third-party chapter. Note (07): a transaction made directly on the internet pays a reduced 0.40% subject to the appendix-E minimum and maximum. Tracking funds (2026-10-31): the exclusion of mutual funds on this line does not cover a tracking fund, so a tracking fund pays this line; a traditional fund that is not listed does not. Place: the existing record of the tariff read on 2026-10-23, note (05) above. On 2026-10-31 the file could not be fetched again (a bot check), so this scope rests on that reading and on the general rule MF-27; on the list for a person to check.
